headword: {学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}

definitions.gloss: student life; college life; school life
definitions.explanation: The period and experience of being a student, encompassing academics, social activities, daily routines, and personal growth during one's school or university years.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんでいる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
{学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{残|のこ}り→残り：01622_nokori⟧わずかになった。
examples.english: My student life has almost come to an end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}した→充実した：16627_juujitsushita⟧{学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧⟦サークル→サークル：10933_saakuru⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: To lead a fulfilling student life, I participated in club activities as well as studies.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧ (student) and ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (life; daily life). Typically refers to university or college life, though it can encompass any period of being a student. A common topic in essays, speeches, and conversations about youth and education in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to lead a student life
- {学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧: to look back on one's student days
- ⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}した→充実した：16627_juujitsushita⟧{学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}: a fulfilling student life
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}: one's last period as a student
